title: Italian Meat Trio, Fresh Mozzarella, Tomato & Pesto Ciabatta Sandwich
originalTitle: Sandwich with mozzarella and tomatoes and meat trio pesto ciabatta
ingredients: 1 large artisan ciabatta loaf, halved horizontally (or 2 ciabatta rolls)
3 tbsp basil pesto + 1 tbsp mayonnaise or balsamic glaze
4 oz thinly sliced prosciutto, soppressata/salami, and mortadella (Italian meat trio)
2 ripe Roma or heirloom tomatoes, sliced and seasoned with salt, pepper & oregano
1 cup fresh arugula tossed with a squeeze of lemon and olive oil
instructions: Slice the ciabatta loaf horizontally, drizzle the cut sides with a touch of olive oil, and toast in a skillet or 400°F oven for 4 minutes until crisp.
Spread basil pesto generously on the bottom half and mayonnaise or balsamic glaze on the top half.
Layer the fresh mozzarella, salted tomato slices, folded ribbons of prosciutto, salami, and mortadella, and peppery lemon-dressed arugula. Press, slice in half, and serve.
